entries.summaryZh: 公元前342年，魏国进攻韩国，齐军以孙膑为军师出兵救援。孙膑用减灶之计示弱诱敌，在马陵道设伏，魏将庞涓追至马陵中伏自尽，魏太子申被俘后处死。此役使魏国丧失霸主地位，齐国成为东方强国，孙膑的用兵也成为中国古代军事谋略的经典案例。
entries.summaryEn: In 342 BCE Wei attacked Han and Qi sent troops to its aid under the strategist Sun Bin, who lured the Wei commander Pang Juan into a narrow defile at Maling by reducing his camp's cooking fires each day to feign desertion. The ambushed Wei army was destroyed, Pang Juan killed himself and Prince Shen was captured, ending Wei's supremacy.
entries.significanceZh: 马陵之战终结了魏国的霸权，确立齐国东方强国的地位，孙膑的减灶诱敌也成为兵家典范。
entries.significanceEn: Maling ended Wei's hegemony, made Qi the leading eastern state and turned Sun Bin's decoy tactics into a classic of Chinese military thought.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基系于战国时期，英文维基给出公元前342年；维基数据P585记为ISO -341年，即民用纪年的公元前342年（本项目无0年）。
entries.notesEn: English Wikipedia gives 342 BCE while Chinese Wikipedia dates the battle to the Warring States period; Wikidata P585 records ISO -341, which is 342 BCE in the civil convention used here.

entries.summaryZh: 公元前207年，项羽率楚军在巨鹿（今河北平乡一带）与秦将章邯、王离所部主力决战。项羽破釜沉舟，先断秦军粮道，再会同诸侯军围歼王离部，章邯八个月后率二十万秦军投降。此役摧毁秦朝赖以立国的主力军团，项羽由此成为各路反秦义军的领袖。
entries.summaryEn: In 207 BCE Xiang Yu led the Chu army against the main Qin forces of Zhang Han and Wang Li at Julu. After burning his boats and breaking his pots to commit his troops, Xiang Yu cut the Qin supply lines and destroyed Wang Li's army; Zhang Han surrendered eight months later, deciding the fall of the Qin.
entries.significanceZh: 巨鹿之战摧毁了秦朝的主力军团，项羽由此成为反秦义军领袖，秦朝的灭亡自此不可逆转。
entries.significanceEn: Julu destroyed the Qin field armies and made Xiang Yu the leader of the rebellion, making the dynasty's fall irreversible.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基与英文维基均系于公元前207年；维基数据P585记为ISO -206年，即民用纪年的公元前207年。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles give 207 BCE; Wikidata P585 records ISO -206, which is 207 BCE in the civil convention used here.

entries.summaryZh: 1953年7月26日，菲德尔·卡斯特罗与劳尔·卡斯特罗兄弟率159名革命者进攻古巴圣地亚哥的蒙卡达兵营，另一路同时攻打巴亚莫的军营，试图推翻巴蒂斯塔政权。行动失败，多数参与者被杀或被囚，卡斯特罗在受审时发表长篇辩护词。此役被广泛视为古巴革命的起点。
entries.summaryEn: On 26 July 1953 Fidel and Raul Castro led 159 revolutionaries in attacks on the Moncada barracks in Santiago de Cuba and a barracks in Bayamo, aiming to overthrow the Batista dictatorship. The assault failed and most of the attackers were killed or captured; the attack is widely seen as the start of the Cuban Revolution.
entries.significanceZh: 蒙卡达兵营行动虽以失败告终，却成为古巴革命的起点，7月26日后来成为卡斯特罗革命运动的名称。
entries.significanceEn: The failed Moncada attack became the founding episode of the Cuban Revolution, and its date gave Castro's movement its name.
entries.notesZh: 中英文维基均系于1953年7月26日；本条只保留年份精度，不折算月日。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles date the attack to 26 July 1953; the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 公元前133年，汉武帝采纳王恢之议，以聂壹为内应，诱匈奴军臣单于进入马邑设伏围歼。单于行至途中察觉有诈，引兵而退，伏击落空。此谋虽未交战，却结束了汉朝对匈奴六十余年的和亲政策，拉开汉匈全面战争的序幕，也促使汉廷转向主动出击的骑兵战略。
entries.summaryEn: In 133 BCE the Han court under Emperor Wu tried to ambush the Xiongnu chanyu Junchen at Mayi, using the merchant Nie Yi as a decoy. The chanyu suspected the trap and withdrew before the Han armies could close it. No fighting took place, but the scheme ended six decades of heqin appeasement and opened the Han-Xiongnu wars.
entries.significanceZh: 马邑之谋虽未成功，却终结了汉匈和亲，标志汉朝对匈奴战略由守势转向全面战争。
entries.significanceEn: The aborted Mayi ambush ended the heqin peace and marked the Han shift from appeasement to open war against the Xiongnu.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基与英文维基均系于公元前133年；维基数据P585记为ISO -132年，即民用纪年的公元前133年。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles give 133 BCE; Wikidata P585 records ISO -132, which is 133 BCE in the civil convention used here.

entries.summaryZh: 191年，讨董联军解体后，袁绍与袁术兄弟反目，双方在阳城交战。袁术部将孙坚自洛阳凯旋后卷入二袁之争，袁绍军一度占据上风，终被孙坚反击击败。公孙瓒之弟公孙越在此役中战死，公孙瓒因此与袁绍结仇，河北与淮南的割据对立由此进一步加深。
entries.summaryEn: In 191, as the coalition against Dong Zhuo broke up, the warlords Yuan Shao and Yuan Shu fought at Yangcheng. Sun Jian, Yuan Shu's subordinate, was drawn into the feud on his return from capturing Luoyang; Yuan Shao's force gained the upper hand first but was beaten back. Gongsun Yue, brother of Gongsun Zan, died in the fighting.
entries.significanceZh: 阳城之战使二袁彻底决裂，并把公孙瓒卷入冲突，加速了东汉末年河北与淮南割据局面的形成。
entries.significanceEn: Yangcheng turned the feud between the two Yuans into open war, drew in Gongsun Zan and hastened the fragmentation of the late Han north.
entries.notesZh: 中英文维基均系于191年；本条只保留年份精度，不折算月日。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles give 191; the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1785年1月20日，西山军将领阮惠在越南南部的沥涔与吹蔑两段河道设伏，以水军诱敌深入，围歼入侵的暹罗军队。暹罗军几乎全军覆没，残部退往柬埔寨。此役挫败了暹罗干涉越南南部的企图，为西山朝统一越南奠定基础，被越南史书列为重大胜利。
entries.summaryEn: On 20 January 1785 the Tay Son commander Nguyen Hue ambushed a Siamese army in the Rach Gam and Xoai Mut reaches of the Tien River in southern Vietnam, luring the fleet into a prepared trap. The Siamese force was almost annihilated and its survivors fled to Cambodia; the victory ended Siamese intervention in the south.
entries.significanceZh: 沥涔吹蔑之战歼灭暹罗干涉军，为西山朝统一越南扫清外部障碍，是越南史上著名的水战胜利。
entries.significanceEn: Rach Gam-Xoai Mut destroyed the Siamese intervention force, cleared the way for Tay Son unification and became a celebrated naval victory in Vietnamese history.
entries.notesZh: 中英文维基均系于1785年1月20日；战役名称在越南语与汉语文献中写法不一，本条采用中文维基的常用写法。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles date the battle to 20 January 1785; the name varies between Vietnamese and Chinese sources and the entry uses the common Chinese form.

entries.summaryZh: 2009年11月10日，朝鲜人民军海军与大韩民国海军在朝鲜半岛西部海域大青岛附近的北方界线一带交火。朝方一艘警备艇越界并首先开火，韩方还击并将其重创，朝方出现人员伤亡。这是继1999年与2002年两次延坪海战之后，双方在西海再次发生的武装冲突。
entries.summaryEn: On 10 November 2009 South and North Korean patrol boats exchanged fire near the Northern Limit Line off Daecheong Island in the Yellow Sea. A North Korean vessel crossed the line and opened fire; the South Korean navy returned fire and badly damaged it, with North Korean casualties. It was the third such clash since 1999.
entries.significanceZh: 大青岛海战是朝韩在北方界线附近发生的又一次武装冲突，反映西海边界争议长期未解。
entries.significanceEn: Daecheong was another armed clash along the disputed Northern Limit Line and showed how unresolved the western sea border remains.
entries.notesZh: 中英文维基均系于2009年11月10日；双方对越界与开火责任的表述不同，本条并记两种说法。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles give 10 November 2009; the two sides describe the crossing and the first shot differently and the entry records the dispute.

entries.summaryZh: 1950年11月5日，朝鲜战争第一次战役期间，中国人民志愿军第39军117师在博川附近的大宁江畔与英联邦第27旅的英澳部队交战，美军提供装甲与炮兵支援。志愿军夜袭一度夺取博川，随后在联合国军火力与反攻下撤出。此役是志愿军入朝后与英联邦部队的首次较大规模交手。
entries.summaryEn: On 5 November 1950, during the Chinese First Phase Offensive of the Korean War, the 117th Division of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army attacked the British and Australian 27th Commonwealth Brigade, supported by American armour and artillery, near Pakchon on the Taeryong River. The Chinese took the village in a night assault before withdrawing.
entries.significanceZh: 博川战斗是志愿军与英联邦部队在朝鲜战场上的首次较大规模交锋，迫使联合国军暂停向鸭绿江推进。
entries.significanceEn: Pakchon was one of the first major clashes between Chinese and Commonwealth forces and halted the UN advance towards the Yalu.
entries.notesZh: 维基数据P585与中英文维基均系于1950年；中文维基条目为小作品，叙述以英文维基与维基数据来源为准。
entries.notesEn: Wikidata P585 and both Wikipedia articles give 1950; the Chinese article is a stub, so the narrative follows the English article and the Wikidata record.
